behavior.name: Test Detection Only
behavior.author: Gabriel Novas
behavior.description:
Camera-robot calibration computed again from the pictures and robot poses already stored for a camera, robot and cell (parameter "cell"), without the robot and without the camera.
Requires, in ~/calibrations/CAMERA/extrinsic_calibration/ROBOT/CELL/: - pictures/ and robot_poses/ and the intrinsic calibration in use of the camera (camera_intrinsics.yaml).
1. The board is detected in the stored pictures (charuco_table_poses/). 2. The ViSP solver computes the pose of the camera (calibration_results/camera_extrinsics.yaml).

param.name: camera_type
param.label: Camera
param.hint: Camera of the calibration (a camera of charuco_calibrator/config/cameras.yaml)

param.name: camera_serial
param.label: Camera Serial
param.hint: Serial number of the camera unit of the pictures (its intrinsic calibration is used); empty: the only RealSense connected

param.name: robot_name
param.label: Robot Name
param.hint: Robot model: it sets the frames and the calibration folder (charuco_calibrator/config/robots.yaml)

param.name: cell
param.label: Cell
param.hint: Cell whose stored pictures and poses are processed (for example right, left, basic, kth_table)

param.name: eye_in_hand
param.label: Eye-in-Hand
param.hint: True if the camera is on the robot
